notes.title: Patch 1.2.9 is here – New Quest Guide System, Combat Improvements & More!
notes.content:
[b]Greetings, Shifters! 🌀[/b]

Today, we’re bringing you an update focused on Quality of Life improvements—many of which were directly requested by you, our amazing community. Patch 1.2.9 delivers a fresh wave of enhancements, bug fixes, and combat tweaks designed to make your journey through The World of Heera smoother, more intuitive, and even more enjoyable. Let’s dive into what’s new!

[h2]🐲 Changelog 1.2.9[/h2]

[b]Changes:[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Grab Mechanic Overhaul:[/b] Enemies now have a chance to become “grabbable” for 4 seconds after being attacked (indicated by an icon). Use the grab button (default: "Interact" button) to grab them—charged attacks no longer grab
[*][b]Waypoint Trackers Per Player:[/b] Each player now has their own tracker in multiplayer and can see others’ trackers
[*]Tentacles now have a slower attack speed but can strike from slightly farther away
[*]Mauling a grabbed enemy ("Interact" while grabbing) now restores a small amount of health even without specific skills
[*]Removed the [i]Explosive Slam[/i] skill from the Houndra skill tree
[*]Alterant variants in a given X-series (e.g. FrX) now share a consistent alterant shape
[/list]

[b]Improvements:[/b]
[list]
[*][b]New Quest Guide System:[/b] Tracked quests now show a yellow diamond icon on the map to guide you. NPCs with new quests are also marked
[*][b]Melee Combat Improvements for Mouse + Keyboard:[/b] Better targeting and movement behavior while melee attacking, especially with the cursor close to the player
[*]You can now remove a single unconfirmed point in the Skill and Beast Mastery tabs
[*]Improved environment visuals through lighting and asset placement tweaks
[*]Added air attacks for [b]Scaptor[/b] and [b]Ramox[/b]
[*]Added slight camera zoom-out 
[*]Made it more clear when a [b]Perasin[/b] has already been collected
[*]Improved code on the startup screen to reduce cases where players get stuck
[*]Alterant sequences now display the required item tags and allow you to inspect individual alterants
[/list]

[b]Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed an issue where the final boss didn’t reset properly after death
[*]Fixed a bug that caused the quest tracker to appear far above its intended location
[*]Map location discovery is now correctly saved and no longer resets when joining or rejoining a game
[*]Lifted enemies (using the Lift Up skill) no longer collide awkwardly with the player
[*]Various quest-related bugs have been resolved
[/list]


[h3]⚠️ Important Notice:[/h3]
Due to the changes in this update, [b]any custom control remaps will be reset[/b]. Please rebind your preferred setup after updating.

We hope this update adds more fun to your experience. As always, we truly appreciate your continued support!

If you enjoy the update, don’t forget to [b]leave a review[/b]—it helps [i]Coridden[/i] grow! 💛
For bug reports or feedback, join us on [b]Discord[/b] or contact us at: [i]contact@aftnareld.com[/i]

[b]Until next time, Shifters![/b]
[i]/Aftnareld Team 🦖[/i]

notes.title: Patch 1.2 is now out! Get ready for a New Game+
notes.content:
[h2]Greetings, Shifters! ✊[/h2]

[b]We are thrilled to announce the release of our latest update, version 1.2, packed with new features and improvements based on your feedback![/b]

[h3]New Game +[/h3]
We’re so excited to share that a feature many of you have been asking for is finally coming to ​Coridden​ – [b]New Game+[/b]! This new mode lets you dive back into the adventure with your existing character save file, keeping all your hard-earned progress and gear. To make things even more thrilling, enemies will be tougher with higher levels, and we’ve added a resistance penalty to increase the challenge even more!

[h3]🐲 Changelog 1.2[/h3]
[b]Added Features:[/b]
- New Game +: Replay with higher enemy levels and resistance penalty
- Max level increased to 80
- 2 more assignable skill slots, 6 skills can now be assigned on each form
- No helm and no creature accessory option in the cosmetics tab
- Transmog feature in the cosmetics tab
- Outline on/off option in the cosmetics tab
- New elemental weapons (both melee and ranged)
- Merchant that sells collars + creature ranged weapons in The Burrow
- "Transfer energy on mount" tutorial info into "Teleport to Creature" tutorial (will change this tutorial title to "Creature Mounts")
- New skill "Seeking Plasma" to energizer tab that cost a bit more energy than other skills but has a low cooldown
- New skill "Tempered Blood" to devotion tab that cast health to cast but has a low cooldown
- A button to cancel ability. Default: Right mouse button or B/ Circle on a controller (rebindable)
- An option to allow virtual player count to make it harder or easier for those who want it
- Camera Rotation Tutorial
- Supporter Pack DLC that includes: Color Picker, Pet companion: Droke, Gold Coating cosmetic, Footprints cosmetic "Titan steps", Footprints cosmetic "The benevolent"

[b]You can read more about it here:[/b]
https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1656930/view/548983985537024795

[b]Changes:[/b]
- Skill Balancing (old character save files will have unplaced points). Some skills have been moved to another tab and others have been placed in another tier. Cooldowns of some skills has been reduced. Damage numbers have been increased/decreased on some skills.
- Resistance alterant gives a higher bonus. Alterant with one resistance type has been increased from 15% to 30%, alterants with elemental or physical resistance has been increased from 7% to 10%.
- Ability power based Healing rate of healing zone has been reduced.
- Weapon damage is now multiplied when performing the Scaptor's Bane skill
- Weapon damage is now multiplied when performing the Summersault attack skill
- Charged pounce is now chargeable, it is also a melee attack when landing
- Stun chance + duration values have generally been decreased on weapons + alterants
- The cost of adding alterant spaces is dependent on the base level of the item
- A favorite marked item can no longer be sold (just unmark it if you want to sell it)
- You can now see the exact stats of a conjure when viewing a conjure skill
- Slightly increased XP penalty when fighting lower level enemies
- Some creature forms now deal elemental melee damage
- LB RB RT LT icons bigger text

[b]Fixes/Improvements:[/b]
- Added icons that shows correct alterant shapes in the alterant sequence pages
- You can now pick up items from the back of a mount
- Added Xp meter next to portrait
- Fixed an issue that prevented beast mastery achievements to unlock when switching from the demo version to the real version
- The game now Autosave your character if dropping out of a local game
- Fixed a bug that made items get stuck in the air

[h3]🐲 What we are working on now[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40886702/0657526f7b2294187eb65b13e0f5f334011189c8.png[/img]

We hope these updates make your journey in Coridden even more enjoyable. Thank you for your continued support and feedback!

And if you haven't done that already, [b]please take a moment to leave a review.[/b] Your feedback is invaluable, and it would help us stand out! And, if you happen to encounter any bugs, please [b]don't hesitate to let us know.[/b] We're actively engaging with our community on Discord, and you can also reach us via email at contact@aftnareld.com.


Follow us on [url=https://twitter.com/aftnareld][b]Twitter/X[/b][/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/aftnareld/][b]Instagram[/b] [/url]and join our [url=https://discord.gg/8kQhswvr8B][b]Discord[/b] [/url]to stay in touch 🦖

Until next time!

notes.content:
[h2]Greetings, Shifters! ✊[/h2]

[b]We’re beyond excited to share that Update 1.2 for ​Coridden​ is now live! [/b]This massive update is built directly on your feedback and requests, and we can’t thank you enough for helping us make the game even better. You can check out all the changes and improvements here:
https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1656930/view/548983985537024558

[b][h3]In addition, we’re thrilled to introduce the ​Coridden​ Supporter Pack! [/h3][/b]
[b]This DLC is filled with purely cosmetic items that won’t affect gameplay[/b] but are designed to add a little extra charm to your adventure 💚

- Fixed issue with Vigorous skill reseting every time when changing zones, also added "Affects both forms" tag

- Fixed issue where the explosion damage (for example in Blast Ranged Weapons) was not displayed correctly in stats (the contribution from the element attribute was not visible)

- Worked on environment issues and improvements in Aasha area

- Added Map indication to Pryia's Headpiece
- Added an examinable text prompt hint where "Mounted Jump" is needed
- Corrected "heavy beast" in rock/wall destroying description to "ramming beast"

notes.title: Discover Quilon's New Look and More
notes.content:
[h2]Greetings, Shifters! ✊[/h2]

[h3]We’re thrilled to share some exciting updates and news about Coridden with you! [/h3]
We've been continuously working on Coridden, and we hope you'll enjoy the improvements we’ve made.

[b]But, first of all, we've got an important announcement.[/b]

[h3]🗓️ [b]Update on Release Date[/b][/h3]
After giving it a lot of thought, we made a difficult decision to release the game with a slight delay. Instead of pushing the game out in December, we’ve agreed Coridden would benefit from having a bit more time to cook. With that in mind, [b]we’re excited to announce that Coridden will be released early next year, in Q1 2025.[/b] This additional time will allow us to further polish the game, ensuring the best possible experience we can provide. Thank you for your understanding and support in this matter.

Now, let's give you a sneak peek at the things we've changed!

[h3][b]🌇 Quilon Rebuilt[/b][/h3]
We’re excited to introduce [b]the updated capital city, Quilon,[/b] home of the Dayal siblings. The city has now a new layout and look, designed to guide you more intuitively through its charming streets. We’ve [b]removed invisible walls[/b] we were never a fan of to enhance immersion and [b]replaced the old houses with modular and performance-friendly structures.[/b] We hope you love the new vibe of Quilon as much as we do! We’re still working on adding some ambient sounds to further enhance that friendly town feel.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40886702/b4bb9f9eb02592393c17c61f217b5b1390918d97.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40886702/40830958e5d67ee7d760a8e2dbd285918a56ef00.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40886702/d3ddb1d5096bffaa1391193781416976f3c2b347.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40886702/116b0870f454dafe05f51ecedb90befa8eb8e8c8.png[/img]

[h3][b]🗡️ Colour Coding Weapons[/b][/h3]
As many of you have shared your challenges in sorting through inventory items, we’ve introduced a [b]slight color-coding system[/b] to make it[b] easier to identify and find the items you’re looking for.[/b] Red indicates heat damage, green for poison, purple for electric, blue for sharp, brown for piercing, and yellow for blunt damage. We’re eager to hear your thoughts on this new feature!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40886702/c9b89b284c2111387b4d4aa3296c0330c5c2bdc2.png[/img]

[h3]💎 [b]Buying Alterant Spaces[/b][/h3]
We’re continuing to refine the Alterant system, similar to “gem slots” in other diablo-like games. You will now be able to [b]purchase additional Alterant spaces for your weapons[/b]! While it’s a bit costly, it’s a great option if you find a weapon you love but need more spaces to enhance it. We’ve also decreased the level multiplier on many Alterants, making them [b]more accessible earlier in the game[/b]. We’re still fine-tuning the balance, so stay tuned for more updates!

Thank you for being with us. We’re excited to continue improving Coridden and can’t wait for you to experience all the new features and updates!

notes.title: Exciting Updates and Enhancements!
notes.content:
[h2]Greetings, Shifters! ✊[/h2]

August is coming to an end, but it's not yet over for us! After showing Coridden at [b]Gamescom in Germany[/b], we're sending it off to [b]the US for PAX West![/b]
https://steamcommunity.com/games/1656930/announcements/detail/4255424837726846472

But that's not all! We're lucky to participate in this year's indie event at the venue — [b]The MIX![/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40886702/8181d77a461b5067c02bc8a8c92a6d81fbdf708a.png[/img]

We've also got some updates rolling in, and we can't wait to share them with you! Our recent playtesting session was a [b]success[/b], and [b]your feedback has been invaluable![/b] We've been busy fixing bugs based on it, and working on completing the game's areas, environments, texts, and translations—[b]it's all slowly coming together[/b] 😊 

To ramp up both [b]challenge [/b]and [b]fun[/b], we decided to try out some changes to [b]skills, items, and gameplay elements.[/b] Here's a peek at what's new:

[h3]🛡️ New Defence Stat for Armours[/h3]
Armours (including beast forms) will now have a [b]Defence[/b] stat. Defence is compared to the [b]Level of the attacker.[/b] If you have a [b]high defence,[/b] it will [b]decrease incoming damage[/b]. Having a[b] low defence[/b] compared to attacker level might lead to [b]more damage[/b] taken. 

We wanted to include this stat as something that every armour can provide to protect you better, even if that armour doesn't have [b]damage resistance or reduction.[/b] This allows for more varied armours, such as an armour providing [b]more ability power [/b]or [b]energy regeneration[/b] instead of just protection.

[h3]🩸 Wound Healing[/h3]
Selected armours will now have a [b]Wound Healing[/b] stat, allowing players to regenerate health while outside of combat.

[h3]🪙 Adjusted Death Penalties[/h3]
Players will now [b]lose money upon death[/b], and the time required to revive an ally has increased slightly from 1 second to 2 seconds, adding a touch more [b]challenge[/b].

[h3]💰 Economy Adjustments[/h3]
We've [b]reduced the overall money drops from enemies[/b] to make a more balanced in-game economy. We hope that as a result, completing quests will feel more rewarding and crucial to progression.

[h3]⚖️ Weapon Damage Balancing[/h3]
We've adjusted both [b]ranged [/b]and [b]melee weapon[/b] damages to maintain a consistent challenge throughout the game.

[h3]🐲 Beast Form Items Drop Rate[/h3]
We've [b]increased the drop chance for beast form items[/b].

[h3]🗡️ Expanded Inventory[/h3]
We've added [b]more inventory space[/b], allowing players to carry more of their hard-earned loot.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40886702/1a3539f371a9c94b61a0b0246401724639ed2978.gif[/img]

[h3]⬆️ Enhanced Damage Resistance for Enemies[/h3]
Enemies' damage resistances will now [b]scale [/b]with [b]higher difficulty levels[/b] and with more players [b]in multiplayer mode[/b]. This change encourages varied playstyles and strategic builds among players tackling tougher challenges together.

[h3]🟠 Improved Item Comparison and Stats Display[/h3]
🔸Damage is now compared [b]directly[/b], regardless of damage type, helping players make quicker, more informed decisions.
🔸 If an item has more than one damage type, a [b]total damage value[/b] will be displayed alongside a breakdown of each damage type's contribution.
🔸We've [b]reorganized item stat displays[/b] to highlight [b]the most important stats at the top[/b], followed by a clear break before the rest, to streamline the comparison process.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40886702/097ae8706bb96b0621db06d19fa71ed83ed656e5.png[/img]

We want to make the game exciting and fun for you every step of the way! [b]Your feedback means the world to us and helps us create this adventure together.[/b] Thanks for sticking with us, and keep an eye out for more updates as we keep building and improving ❤️

Until next time!

We're back with another changelog! As always, we've been hard at work adding more content to the game. We've shared some of the improvements in our last Dev Update - check it out if you haven't already!
https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1656930/view/7723185311647615065

[h2]New moves[/h2]
Our beasts have been training hard and it shows! Not only has Ramox learned some new moves, but Panteliz has also been honing new skills. We can't wait to show you two of their new moves - what do you think?? 😀
[h3]Charged Pounce[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40886702/6865502e1f03d6029d33e0cd25918409216fc4a2.gif[/img]
[h3]Deadly Spin[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40886702/e76b7e3d1b422ab126d44efa9e8f6c0ed03d6de5.gif[/img]

[h2]Damage types and stacking effects[/h2]
In our discord we had some interesting discussion around damage types and effect stacking lately, and questions about how it works in Coridden came up. For you who are interested, here is a quick overview for how damage over time and damage status effects currently work:

Damage over time stacks. So if you successfully scorch an enemy with 10 dmg for 4 sec and then successfully scorch the same enemy 2 seconds later with 5 dmg for 2 sec, the enemy will take 15 damage for the remaining 2 seconds. However, the debuff from the damage status effect does not stack. For example, a scorched enemy always takes 50% more physical damage no matter how many "stacks" of scorch it has. Concerning area of effect (AOE) damage, if an enemy stands in 2 AOE attacks it will take damage from both. It works in the same way for both singleplayer and multiplayer.
More than inflict damage over time, each status effect also debuff enemies in different ways:

[b]🩸 Bleeding[/b]: enemies take additional elemental damage.
[b]⚗️ Poison[/b]: prevents enemies from healing.
[b]⚡ Shock[/b]: causes enemies to deal less damage, it will also decrease their accuracy and cooldown speed of abilities.
[b]🔥 Scorch[/b]: enemies take additional physical damage.

[h2]Minimap[/h2]
And finally, we're in the process of implementing a mini-map. We're still tweaking its looks, but we're excited to give you a sneak peek 👀

notes.title: Attributes? What are those? 🤔
notes.content:
[h2]Greetings, Shifters! ✊🐲  [/h2]
 
We think that[b] a fun RPG lets you customize and specialize your character in different ways[/b]. So when developing Coridden, we wanted to find ways for players to do just that. Instead of just passively getting better when gaining a level, we added an [b]attribute system[/b] where you can choose what your character should become better at. In this update, we want to dive a bit more into how attributes work in our game!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40886702/d759d1c2532df30d5e8869d306cd171cfe1f052f.png[/img]
The five attributes to choose from — Power, Fragmentation, Stabilization, Battery, and Element — each one enhances a different aspect of your character. Whenever a player[b] levels up their gauntlets[/b], they'll gain 2 attribute points to freely assign to any of the 5 attributes. There's also possible to find [b]additional attribute points[/b] scattered around the world, so remember to explore, and your efforts will be rewarded ✨

The attributes give various passive upgrades to your characters, both to your human and your monster form:
🐲 [b]Power[/b] —  increases physical melee damage;
🐲 [b]Fragmentation[/b] —  increases physical projectile damage and status effect’s damage over time (for example, if you manage to poison an enemy it deals more damage);
🐲 [b]Stabilization[/b] — improves health and reduces the chance to get staggered by the enemy;
🐲 [b]Battery[/b] — increases max energy and energy recharge rate;
🐲 [b]Element [/b]—  increases elemental damage and ability power (which in turn improves some active skills).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40886702/dab38b913ac9b5c0150bfbbcc0fb24918ce126d7.gif[/img]

Attributes are not only important for these passive bonuses, however, as some skills might benefit and be improved from certain attributes — so [b]you can improve skills by upgrading attributes[/b]!

Do you upgrade your gauntlet's power to increase physical melee damage? Or do you focus on fragmentation to improve your projectile physical damage and damage over time? [b]The choice is yours[/b].

What build will you be going for? Let us know in the comments!

notes.content:
[b]Greetings Shifters [/b]✊🐲

During last month (september) we were fully dedicated to fixing all different sorts of issues, bugs and requests we received from all the incredible people who helped us playtest our alpha (act 1)! Here are some of the many changes we’ve implemented this month:
[list]
[*] [b]Main Menu UI/UX Improvements:[/b] We hope that our latest changes will make it easier to handle save files and setting up your game. (There are still areas in the Main menu we are planning to improve/change)
[*] [b]Dropdown option list for items in inventory:[/b] With these new options you can do standard actions such as drop, equip etc, but also mark items as “trash” or “favorite” to easier manage your inventory and sell the items you are not interested in keeping. 
[*] [b]Added a simple “Respec store”:[/b] If you’re not happy with your character upgrade choices, you can reset your character and place your points into new skill specializations for a cost. The cost, how much you can reset etc are still up for debate as this is in an early stage and not tested enough yet!
[*] [b]Added possibility to choose dialogue answers with keyboard numbers (1,2,3,4) [/b]
[*] [b]Updated Item compare function:[/b] So now all relevant stats are shown on both items always (Example: If you equip a armor with money picking +10% it will now tell you will lose 10% money picking when switching to a armor that doesn't have that effect)
[*] [b]Added new VFX for charging weapons:[/b] To more clearly indicate when your weapon is fully charged to perform a stronger attack. 
[/list]

Now we are going to focus on adding and fixing more content such as new areas, quests and items in preparation for the next playtest session!

notes.content:
[h3]Greetings Shifters! ✊🐲[/h3]

It’s Gamescom times, but we unfortunately aren’t attending this year. Instead we're staying at home working hard on the game in preparation for the exciting things ahead! We’ll share some news on that with you down below, but first a little update on some of the things we’ve been working on this month:

[b]Conjures are back![/b]

We’ve been working on making the conjures (summons) work properly, and added a conjure skill to every class! Conjured beasts are not only helpful in fights to draw aggro and do damage, they can also be ridden. Any passive skill that requires riding will work both when using a conjure and when riding another player.

We wanted to try this change to give you more control over when you want to use that heal, and also add in the co-op trouble of choosing who should get the health boost. 😉

[b]New enemy type (kind of)[/b]

Some of you may recognize this enemy as the old “demo boss”, now that the “new boss” has more of the right thematic feel (electric) the “old” one has gotten a behavior remake and is now a tougher variant that can shield itself from your attacks.

[i]The "Head-plated" Roker enemy. Name still work in progress, we'll see if we can come up with something better soon![/i]

[b]Finally, [/b] we’ve been working on polishing up a couple of new areas, writing, adding quests, and preparing a new build we call “Alpha Act 1”. This version will soon be available to download and playtest early for our [url=https://discord.gg/invite/fFdRsDW6Af]discord members[/url] and on the playtesting platform [url=https://gameround.co/]G.Round[/url]! notes.title: Updated demo - April edition!
notes.content:
[b]Hey Shifters![/b] 🐲

Since the last news update we’ve managed to get quite a lot of new improvements and changes to the demo. Today we’ve also uploaded a newer version, fixing some issues that have popped up and added more new skills to try out.

Parallel with working on the main game we’re continuously working with updating our demo and so we’d love to hear your feedback and suggestions here on the forums or on our [url=https://discord.gg/invite/fFdRsDW6Af]Discord[/url]!

✨[b]Changes in today's demo update:[/b] 
[list]
[*] Support for rebinding to move to cursor on mouse and keyboard
[*] Added a manual save button in game tab
[*] New active & passive skills (Rapid Aim, Flame Strike, Hurl Healing Ball, Weapon Masteries, Gouge, Combustible Hit, Lethal Weapon, Durable traps, Shade Away, The Elementalist and more)
[*] Removed energy cost from melee weapons
[*] Updated/added new active skills, passive skills and skill levels
[*] Lowered the cooldowns of most skills
[*] Store now looks like inventory and you can sort the items by category
[*] Updated multiple active & passive skills (Flame Jet, Shock Bolt, Leap Attack, Homing Bolt, Explosive Trap and more)
[*] Hunter class can now place up to 3 traps simultaneously 
[*] Improved aiming with bow/crossbow feels more precise with controller
[*] Tweaked object interaction responsiveness 
[/list]
🔧[i]Fixes[/i] 
- Remap setting are now be saved when using a Player Profile
- Fixed a bug where the player didn’t start at the right location when loading a game in online multiplayer
- Fixed a bug that made the quest progression go out of sync in online multiplayer
- Fixed a bug where the skills was not saved/loaded correctly
- Fixed so chests aren’t empty when looted
- Fixed bug where it sometimes was possible to talk to Ira in the middle of the first wave, triggering the boss too early

👊[b]Earlier demo improvements this month: [/b]
[list]
[*] MKB Aim & Controls: Player character now turns towards mouse position when in combat. Standard control scheme for Keyboard & Mouse is changed to make   it easier to dodge + cast skills, (dodge bu taping the right mouse button) 
[*] MKB Ability casting: Using an active ability that shoots a projectile is changed so that pressing the ability button (number 1, 2, 3, or 4) starts to aim the ability and is then fired by pressing the left mouse button
[*] Controller ability casting: Using an abilities that shoots a projectile is now fired by releasing the aim ability button (LB)
[*] Class UX: UI/UX for Human Class skills now have a skill-tree style structure with multiple Skill Tabs (2 for now per Human Class).
[*] Playable Creatures: Scaptor and Ramox creatures can now be played in the demo, if found and defeated in “Guard Missions”.
[*] Skills: New and improved (VFX, balancing) skills for humans and beasts to try out!
[*] Inventory Overview: Player can now view items in inventory by category, and items are automatically sorted by level (highest to lowest) 
[*] Inventory Tabs: The inventory is now expanded with two tabs/boxes that can be switched between (more tabs/boxes can be added later on if needed).
[*] Saving: It’s now possible to save the game and character progress.
[*] Map look: New VFX shader for the map
[*] Video Tutorials: Tutorial pop-ups now also have a video that shows how the player should do certain things. The tutorials are now closed with the button it wants you to press instead of E on keyboard and Y on controller.
[*] Difficulty: Now higher difficulty also gives higher chance for rare drops (description in-game updated as well)
[/list]
🔧[i]Fixes [/i] 
- Worked on making it more responsive to perform active abilities for Human Class skills and Beast Mastery skills
- Moved tutorials to the side, not to obstruct the player too much
- Fixed issue where character choice in main menu can be ignored 
- Moved Chief Arjun (Guard mission quest giver) so the guard missions primarily are found if exploring the city
- When host ends a multiplayer session, the joined in players no longer get stuck in a loading screen
- Players can no longer move while equipping gauntlets cutscene plays
- Fixed a bug where the aiming behaved weird. This was very annoying

🖊️[i]In progress/Known Issues [/i]
- Issue where players can get stuck in loading screen when defeated in a Guard Mission (hard to replicate) 
- Issue where the game gets very slow when too many enemies are engaged in Guard Mission, that can disconnect an online game session
- Map VFX can sometimes not work on certain computers, only UI is visible
- Class Skill Tabs still being worked on, some of them now have very few skills 
- Working on changing so Passive Skills have circular frames while Active Skills have rectangular frames to make them more distinct from each other

Lately we’ve been taking in a lot of feedback and using it to try to improve and polish the gameplay.
We’ve mainly been doing a lot of smaller fixes and upgrades, but one big design change we decided to implement is that [b]you now have two energy bars:[/b] one for your human form and one for your beast form. Both melee and ranged attacks now cost energy, with melee attack damage being significantly reduced if you’re out of energy. This will give you a good reason to use, equip and upgrade both your human and melee form, making the combat more interesting and varied!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40886702/0783bd313b72b160528b6cdc8fe1d109cef1fdc9.gif[/img]
[i]New feature: two energy bars[/i]

Some other things we’ve been working on:
[list]
[*] Making movement look and feel more smooth and responsive
[*] Improving VFX, primarily the different elemental damage type attacks
[*] Make it easier to navigate and polished up some demo levels
[*] Improving UX, mainly for Class selection and Player health/energy bars
[*] Changed up the horde mode in the demo, so you now face more varied enemy waves
[*] Added new item slot: Creature Accessory (only affecting stats)
[*] Improving loot drops modifications so it is possible to receive a greater variety of randomized items with higher rarities (highest chance to see these items is to play the horde mode)
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40886702/b5b562a9448ece71bfcd5eeda2ecda81626b12a1.gif[/img]

notes.title: Beast masteries, new animations and more - Dev Update #1 2022
notes.content:
[b]Hey creatures of all kind![/b]

We’ve really gotten up to speed again after the holiday break in January, and as the short month of February is coming to an end, I wanted to write about some of the things we’ve been working on lately:

To make our world feel more alive and lively, we’ve animated the people in town. Now they’re talking, walking and overall having a more exciting life than before. Also, we’ve been working on another friendly creature that you’ll be able to see flying around in town later on.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40886702/f672f19ec98a85f9072c2f67a74a325bd9558fc7.gif[/img]

We’ve been continuing working on making the combat feel and look better, polishing animations, control and effects. The difference between light and heavy (charged) attack should be more apparent now! Also we added health drops from enemies, as it was requested by many to have more ways to get health back.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40886702/9e090b172a6e0a5685f4b715f36eb3ed99adf8de.gif[/img]

We’ve added a new little teaser in the form of a “coming soon” tab in the character menu, namely the “Beast Mastery” tab (name not final). Here you will be able to upgrade your different creature forms with new bonuses, skills etc. as you level them up. [b]Hope you’re as excited for this one as we are![/b]

notes.title: The Big but Short 2021 Update!
notes.content:
This year is coming to an end, and we wanted to take the time to summarise what we’ve been working on this year since the demo week last summer! (If you’ve read the weekly updates on our discord server then this may not be much news, but more of a recap.) 

[b][i]We have an updated playable demo available early to our [url=https://discord.gg/invite/fFdRsDW6Af]Discord community[/url], so if you want to try it out during the holidays, go ahead and download it there! [/i][/b]

We could write a whole page of what we’ve been up to, but we don’t want to drag things out walls of text... So here is a list of some things we’ve been working on instead:
[list]
[*] Added 2 new creature variations
[*] Worked on levels and quests for the main story line
[*] New environments (also updates to environments in demo)
[*] Updated character models
[*] Updated animations
[*] Added new melee weapon categories for humans: heavy weapons & dual wield 
[*] New music
[*] Remap system (still early version)
[*] Various UI/UX updates (this is something we are going to work even more on early next year!)
[*] Design and implementation of classes and skills. They are very much still under development, but you can try out a limited portion in the latest demo!
[/list]
So what's to come for 2022? Our current plan is to have a Kickstarter campaign early next spring, as we decided to push it forward to make a better demo before we ask anyone to pledge to our campaign - we want to put out something great for you to play and show our commitment to this project! And we want to of course continue adding more content and polish into the game, working on story, quests, UI and UX, classes, skills, items, levels, creatures… The list goes on ;) We’re going to publish an approximate roadmap for you at the latest during the Kickstarter campaign. 

We’re still in a stage where we are able to change a lot of things, so if you want to help us and make an impact on the game - don’t hesitate to let us know what you like and don’t like! 

[i]Have a wonderful holiday, wishing you all a merry christmas and a happy new year.
Hope you are as excited as we are for what's to come for Coridden in 2022![/i]
